title: Nébulo

visual.meshes: custom polygon outlines, bevelled extrusions, tubing, gearing, decorated castings; props may use standard primitives

rig.jointSystem: hierarchical named pivots with 2D planar two-bone inverse kinematics

motion.contactRule: seed follows actual wrist world transform while gripped
motion.noClaim: No bone-skinned animations or physics simulation

behavior.logic: state timelines, gaze tilt, blink, joint-target IK

routeComparison.name: Ilustración 2.5D articulada
routeComparison.method: SVG cutout shapes with transform-origin joints; good for authored faces and low-GPU execution
routeComparison.tradeoff: Not a volumetric reusable 3D mesh; profile and glTF output would be compromised

routeComparison.name: Modelado paramétrico de superficie dura
routeComparison.method: Authored silhouette contours extruded with bevels and transform hierarchy in Three.js; user can orbit model and export to GLB
routeComparison.tradeoff: No texture UV atlas, bone skin or morph targets; expressive mechanics implemented at nodes

preproductionReason: Original automaton is a mechanical, not human figure; revolving and inspectable joints are the core brief. Custom cast-part contours avoid decorative stacks of cubes and produce mesh geometry without needing licensed third-party models.
useInOtherProjects: IMPORT_GLB_FOR_STATIC_HIERARCHY; adapt animation controller source for live acting
